result.instructions: Tools for Fakturowo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my unpaid invoices from this month."; "Show invoice 818950 with all its line items."; "Issue a VAT invoice to Jan Kowalski for 3 hours of consulting at 200 PLN net, 23% VAT.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fakturowo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fakturowo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fakturowo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fakturowo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. fakturowo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fakturowo_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List invoices and other documents on the account, 100 per page: id (api_numer), type, number, issue and sale date, currency, net/VAT/gross value, seller and buyer, payment status, due date and KSeF number. Filter by document type or by seller/buyer tax number. Values are the vendor's own (dates DD-MM-YYYY; dokument_rodzaj is the type code with a readable name for common types). Fakturowo api_zadanie=3.

seller_tax_id.description: Only documents of the seller with this tax number (NIP).

buyer_tax_id.description: Only documents of the buyer with this tax number (NIP).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 rows per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: fakturowo_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: One document by its id (api_numer, from fakturowo_list_documents or the id returned when it was created): the header fields and every line item (name, unit, quantity, net/gross price, discount, VAT rate and amount, gross value). Fakturowo api_zadanie=3 with api_numer.

tools.name: fakturowo_get_next_document_number
tools.title: Get next document number
tools.description: The running number Fakturowo will give the next document of a type (the sequence counter saved on the account). Nothing is created. Fakturowo api_zadanie=8.

tools.name: fakturowo_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the saved clients (contractors), 100 per page: id (api_numer), name, address, tax number, contact details, account number and notes. PESEL and ID-card numbers are never returned. Fakturowo api_zadanie=4.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 rows per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: fakturowo_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: One saved client by id (api_numer, from fakturowo_list_clients). PESEL and ID-card numbers are never returned. Fakturowo api_zadanie=4 with api_numer.

tools.name: fakturowo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the saved products and services (the catalogue used on documents), 100 per page: id (api_numer), name, unit, VAT rate, net price, gross value, currency, comment, GTU code and discount. Fakturowo api_zadanie=6.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 100 rows per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: fakturowo_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One saved product by id (api_numer, from fakturowo_list_products). Fakturowo api_zadanie=6 with api_numer.

tools.name: fakturowo_create_document
tools.title: Create document
tools.description: WRITE: issue a new document (invoice, proforma, receipt...) on the account. It is saved immediately and takes the next number in its sequence; this tool cannot delete it again, and calling it twice issues two documents. Issue documents one at a time and wait for each reply: Fakturowo says overlapping saves can get the same number when the account's numbering check is off. Needs a buyer and at least one line item; the seller defaults to what the account has saved only if Fakturowo allows that, otherwise pass seller. Returns the new document's id (api_numer); with public_links true also a public PDF and preview link (anyone with the link can open the document). Fakturowo api_zadanie=1.

first_name.description: Seller first name (for a private person with no business name).

last_name.description: Seller last name (for a private person with no business name).

private_person.description: True for a private person that runs no business (then first and last name are needed).

tax_id.description: Seller tax number (NIP, or a VAT id).

country.description: Two-letter country code (PL, DE...), default PL.

first_name.description: Buyer first name (for a private person with no business name).

last_name.description: Buyer last name (for a private person with no business name).

private_person.description: True for a private person that runs no business (then first and last name are needed).

tax_id.description: Buyer tax number (NIP, or a VAT id).

country.description: Two-letter country code (PL, DE...), default PL.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as enabled on the account: "23", "8", "5", "0", "zw" (exempt), "np"...

net_price.description: Net unit price. Give either net_price or gross_value.

gross_value.description: Gross value of the line (the vendor field is `produkt_wartosc_brutto`). Give either net_price or gross_value.

place.description: Place of issue (default: the account's saved place).

paid_amount.description: Amount already paid (subtracted from the total).

public_links.description: Return public PDF and preview links (default false).

tools.name: fakturowo_set_document_payment_status
tools.title: Set document payment status
tools.description: WRITE: change the payment status of an existing document (unpaid, paid, partially_paid) and optionally the amount already paid. Only those fields are sent; Fakturowo edits the document in place. Fakturowo api_zadanie=1 with api_numer.

paid_amount.description: Amount already paid (for partially_paid, or to record the amount).
